notes: Two independent fixes combined into this OTA step. (1) Fixed the 'Start Wi-Fi produces no AP broadcast, no error, no output' bug: field_console.py's start_ap() had 'while not ap.active(): time.sleep(0.2)' with NO TIMEOUT -- if the CYW43439 radio wasn't ready yet right after the machine.reset() that got here (same shared-radio settle issue already worked around on the BLE side), this hung forever silently. Now times out after 8s with a clear diagnostic, and disables BLE + waits 250ms before ap.active(True) (ensure_ble_off(), mirroring ble_service.py's ensure_wifi_off()). Also fixed main.py: 'import field_console' (which starts the AP) sat inside the SAME try block as the os.stat('wifi_mode.txt') existence check, with 'except OSError:' checked before 'except Exception:', so any OSError from starting the AP was silently misreported as 'no wifi_mode.txt file, starting BLE instead' -- main.py now determines which mode was requested BEFORE trying to start either one. (2) Added a maps_link column to GPS_Log (plain https://www.google.com/maps?q=lat,lon URL -- Google Sheets auto-links plain http(s):// text the same way Apps Script's sheet.appendRow() writes it, no =HYPERLINK() formula needed) and fixed the real reason GPS_Log stayed empty while Power_Log kept getting rows: sheets_log.py's log_gps() existed but NOTHING ever called it. New SheetsLogger.log_gps_now() reuses the already-open cellular modem's UART to get one GPS fix attempt (20s best-effort) and logs it with status='fix' or 'no_fix'; wired into both the BLE 'log' command and the web console's Log Now page, with power/GPS outcomes tracked independently. sheets_bootstrap.py's GPS_Log header list now includes maps_link -- re-run it (or add the column by hand) so an existing sheet picks up the new header.
